simple.summary: חוֹב (chôwb) means debt First listed occurrence: Ezek 18 7.

definitions.full: H2326. chob חוֺב noun [masculine] debt (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic , חוֺבָא ); — ח ׳חֲבֹלָתוֺ יָשִׁיב Ezek 18:7 his pledge as to indebtedness he restores , see Hi-Sm Ew § 291 b Ges § 132 R 5, b Kö Lgb. i. 497 f. and compare Dr § 193 (but construction hard: Co שׁוֺב ; dittograph from ׳חבל Bev Daniel 1. 10 , compare 18:12 ; v: 16).
